free_tier.stated: 500 free build minutes/month on macOS M2 (individuals). No free storage allowance advertised. Artifact retention is per-team policy; Enterprise default is 1 year.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: No retention clause documented in available terms.

egress.terms: Free via api.codemagic.io artifact URLs; 'No expiration' download links are a documented option.

tooling: POST /artifacts/:secureFilename/public-url with expiresAt, returning a public URL; GET /artifacts/:secureFilename. API token required (`x-auth-token`).
chaining: Unlimited accounts x 500 free minutes; artifact volume is bounded by what you can build in 500 min/month. 'No expiration' links mean the URL outlives nothing. The artifact is still deleted by team retention policy.
limits_note: 500 min/month free. 'No expiration' applies to the LINK, not the artifact. Retention policy still deletes the file (explicit in their KB). Build dashboards give only 24-hour artifact links.

identity_cost.detail: no identity_cost field and no identity statement in the source record; defaulted to email and flagged, not evidence

reliability_note: 'No expiration' is a misleading label: the link persists but the artifact is removed by retention policy, so links rot. 500 min/month is a hard build ceiling.
